svg.title: Source–readout formulation. The target objects of this subsection are functions and events on the finite configuration space Cn = GΛn×{0,1,2,3}, which is the readout space U of Theorem 7.1 for the torus Λn. The realized sector is Z = GV ×GE with readout π(r, A)e = r−1 x Aery and section σ(U) = (1, U). An activity datum is lifted by composition: every regular representative, forced coefficient and predicate F is replaced by F ◦π, while every piece of lattice bookkeeping (anchor, support, inventory, address list, scope) is copied unchanged into the raw tuple. The operations to be lifted are the flag map, the mask, the left increment and its ordered derivatives, the signed lattice permutations, and the sums defining the budgets and the norm. The fibre of π is the frame orbit; the statements below show that all of these operations commute with π and that every number defined in (AB1)–(AB12) is constant on that fibre. The exactness class is an embedding with section: nothing in the budgets is enlarged, sharpened or lost.
